name: Managed In-App Update Handoff Hotfix
changes: Restores one-click About & Updates orchestration using verified Setup in managed /SILENT update mode.
Closes the browser-hosted NewzDeck UI before file overlay, then closes/waits for tray and service before installation.
Restores service/tray state and relaunches NewzDeck after managed silent updates without reviving the Defender-sensitive copied Picker coordinator.
Hardens the guarded publisher so Pages is evaluated for the final trigger commit rather than a superseded source-commit deployment.
regression_guards: About & Updates must launch verified Setup with /update /SILENT while retaining CLOSEAPPLICATIONS/FORCECLOSEAPPLICATIONS.
Managed silent Setup must close the app window before tray/service shutdown and file overlay.
Managed silent updates must relaunch NewzDeck; CI /VERYSILENT update smoke installs must remain non-relaunching.
The copied NewzDeckUpdateHandoff/Picker coordinator architecture must remain retired.
preserved: v3.7.2 runtime identity coherence and source-complete packaging.
In-process SABCTools 9.6.3, split NNTP fetch/decode pipeline, and Python emergency yEnc fallback.
Private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Direct Unpack/post-processing, article cache, async disk, Automation, Smart Import, Newsgroup Browser, Backup & Restore, and all twelve themes.
